chip.description: Three-voice mono wavetable sound generator reading 32-byte 4-bit waveforms from PROM; the sound of Pac-Man, Pengo, Dig Dug and their contemporaries (taxonomy §4.13 example).
chip.notes: src/devices/sound/namco.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("NAMCO WSG sound driver ... 3-voice mono (PROM-based design: Pac-Man, Pengo, Dig Dug, etc)").
